unresolved_integrations.resolution: Agree versioned API/engine/target/evidence contracts, select actual pack versions and pin accepted integration results; this map cannot grant readiness.
Complete Core-owned packs/delivery with their own evidence, then accept real Godot consumer games. Do not wait for Unity or require the same journey twice.
Qualify real server resources, PostgreSQL, tenant/account/age boundaries, secret protection and hostile workloads; local SQLite contracts and server availability do not qualify hosting.
Use one Cloud rights decision service with source/asset provenance. Core owns neutral digest/lineage mechanics, not legal rights. Check remix inputs without adding 040 -> 043 and creating a cycle.
Obtain actual engine/toolchain/hardware/partner evidence only for supported profiles. Local-only requires no-egress proof; Unity and console remain outside the first Godot gate.
Independently approve commercial policy and the signed GA scope with enabled-feature gates. Mapping, simulated payment events and non-game examples cannot approve a release.
